name: discord_api
description: Call Discord's REST API as this bot, with its own token (no setup needed). Use it to read channel history or a message (GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages?limit=20 via query), look up users, channels, a guild and its members, post a message or a file to any channel the bot can see (POST /channels/{id}/messages with body {"content": ...} and optional file_path under /data), edit or delete the bot's OWN messages (PATCH/DELETE /channels/{id}/messages/{id}), react (PUT /channels/{c}/messages/{m}/reactions/{emoji}/@me), pin, start threads, create and read polls (POST a message with a "poll" object), and DM someone (POST /users/@me/channels {"recipient_id": ...} then post to the returned channel id). Returns {status, ok, data, error?}. IDs are the long numeric snowflakes; the current channel's id is usually in the conversation. Not allowed here: guild administration - creating or deleting channels, roles, kicking, banning, webhooks, invites, or touching other people's messages; an owner can have a dedicated tool built for those. Discord's 10 MB upload limit applies to file_path. For attaching a file to your current reply prefer attach_file; use this when the file must go to another channel or a DM.

body.description: JSON body for POST/PATCH, e.g. {"content": "hello"} or with "embeds", "poll", "message_reference"

file_path.description: a file under /data to upload with a POST /channels/{id}/messages

file_name.description: name to give the uploaded file (default: the file's own)
